observable_control: O1r = feature-major current + causal mean/std/slope at decision widths 4,8,16,32

probe.selection: pooled validation AP; exact ties choose smaller C
probe.scaler: StandardScaler fit on train rows only

cohort: anomaly versus legitimate drift; mixed/stable/stationary excluded from primary

uncertainty.method: exploratory hierarchical bootstrap, source first then detector seeds

decision_rule.survival_support: mean primary contrast >= 0.02 and pooled-seed contrast >= 0.02 in at least 2 of 3 seeds
decision_rule.status: descriptive exploratory classification only; no GO/STOP rule
